cross_verification.note_en: Qatar visas (entry permits) are administered by MOI at portal.moi.gov.qa/qatarvisas; Hayya is a separate system for certain event-linked entry. Direct fetches of the MOI visa portal, MOI visas-entry-permits department page, and MOFA (mofa.gov.qa) visas page returned no photo specification content — MOFA's page explicitly redirects applicants to moi.gov.qa for visa-type details without stating photo specs. As with qa-passport, third-party aggregator sites disagree with each other on size and background color, so none of those figures are cited here per policy.
